contract:
You are reviewing one live system of the Mag estate (a local-first agent harness on Windows). Assume it runs in production tonight. Review it as an adversarial engineer.

Reply with EXACTLY this shape and nothing else:

IMPROVEMENT 1: <one-line defect or weakness claim> | EVIDENCE: <repo-relative path>:<line or line-range> | FIX: <one-line fix>
IMPROVEMENT 2: <same shape>
IMPROVEMENT 3: <same shape>
DIFFERENT-BUILD: <at most 60 words: the one thing you would build differently and why>

LAWS:
- Every EVIDENCE cite must be a real path and real line numbers of the system below (the path as printed in one of the two SOURCE headers; cite either file).
- Rank by damage: IMPROVEMENT 1 is the worst defect.
- No em-dash characters anywhere in the reply.
- No praise, no docstring restatement, no speculation presented as fact; a claim you cannot ground in the source below must be dropped, not guessed.

<SOURCE path=scripts/descent_driver.sh sha256=1ac6a0f37700c3b7>
{RUNNER PASTES FULL BYTES OF scripts/descent_driver.sh HERE}
</SOURCE>
<SOURCE path=watch/inbox/hermes_burn/WAVE24_BOARD.md sha256=0965be68341a3b3d>
{RUNNER PASTES FULL BYTES OF watch/inbox/hermes_burn/WAVE24_BOARD.md HERE}
</SOURCE>

checks.name: SHAPE
checks.rule: regex finds exactly 3 IMPROVEMENT n: lines then exactly 1 DIFFERENT-BUILD: section, nothing else

checks.name: CITES-RESOLVE
checks.rule: every EVIDENCE path (strip :line suffix) exists on disk in the repo (either surface legal)

checks.name: LINES-IN-RANGE
checks.rule: every cited line number <= line count of the cited file

checks.name: NO-EM-DASH
checks.rule: zero 0xE2 0x80 0x94 sequences in the reply bytes

checks.name: DISTINCT-EVIDENCE
checks.rule: the 3 cites hit >= 2 distinct (path, 50-line bucket) targets

grader.rollup: cluster all families' EVIDENCE cites by (path, 50-line bucket); >= 2 families on one cluster = convergent defect candidate
